settings.text: Frequently Asked Questions

settings.heading: How much does US shipping cost?

settings.text: We offer free standard US shipping on all orders over $50. Orders under $50 ship for a flat rate of $4.90 (Economy) within the United States.

settings.heading: How long does order processing and delivery take?

settings.text: Orders are processed within 1–2 business days (excluding weekends and US holidays). Once dispatched, standard US delivery takes 5–10 business days.

settings.heading: What is your return and refund policy?

settings.text: We offer a 30-day return window from delivery for unused items in original packaging, with free US return shipping and no restocking fees. Approved refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5–10 business days.

settings.heading: How can I track my order?

settings.text: As soon as your order ships, we email a shipping confirmation with your tracking number. Please allow 24–48 hours for carrier scans to update.

settings.heading: Can I cancel or exchange my order?

settings.text: You can request a cancellation anytime before fulfillment by emailing admin@healtence.com with your order number. We do not offer direct exchanges—simply request an eligible return and place a new order.

settings.heading: Who operates Healtence, and how can I contact support?

settings.text: Healtence is operated by Kinwood LLC in Daniels, West Virginia. Reach our support team at admin@healtence.com or +1 304-237-1573 (Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST).
